findings.title: Single use/single service articles are properly stored and used.
findings.comment: Inspector observed single service articles stored on the floor in the dry storage area (black door). Discussed with the person in charge (PIC). Food contact surfaces should be stored at least 6 inches above the ground to protect against potential contamination. Reorganize or obtain shelving (or milk crates) to store single service articles above the ground.
findings.citation_text: 4-903.11(A) Equipment, Utensils, Linens, and Single-Service and Single-Use Articles. (A) Except as specified in (D) of this section, cleaned EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS, laundered LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES shall be stored: (1) In a clean, dry location; (2) Where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination; and (3) At least 15 cm (6 inches) above the floor. [C]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Inspector observed loose and missing coving in the hallway and restrooms. Place and seal coving by the next routine inspection to protect walls from water entry.
findings.citation_text: 6-201.13(A) Floor and Wall Junctures, Coved, and Enclosed or Sealed. (A) In FOOD ESTABLISHMENTS in which cleaning methods other than water flushing are used for cleaning floors, the floor and wall junctures shall be coved and closed to no larger than 1 mm (one thirty-second inch). [C]
